Source: `submodules/lfric_apps/`

LFRic Apps is home to the LFRic-based science applications and libraries, including the **Momentum® Atmosphere** model and the **GungHo dynamical core**.

## Structure

```
lfric_apps/
├── applications/     # Model application entry points
├── science/          # Science parameterisations and schemes
├── interfaces/       # Inter-component interfaces
├── rose-meta/        # Rose metadata for suite configurations
├── rose-stem/        # Rose/Cylc test suite
└── documentation/    # Sphinx-based docs
```

## Example Suites

- `u-dn674` — MetOffice Azure SPICE (low-res LFRic Atm NWP GAL9)
- `u-dn704` — MetOffice EX HPC (low-res LFRic Atm NWP GAL9)
